subject: Shoply POC: success criteria, model fallback plan & owners
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Clara Huang <clara@shoply.com>, Daniel Ortiz <d.ortiz@shoply.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Aug 2028 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Shoply POC: success criteria, model fallback plan & owners

Hi Clara / Daniel — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned ahead of the trial kickoff.

Summary of ask
- Goal: 2-week proof-of-concept to validate product search relevancy + conversational assistant for returns flow (EN + ES).
- Acceptance: session-level CTR improvement >= 8% vs baseline and NPS-style usability >= 4/5 on internal QA prompts.

Proposed trial scope (suggested)
1) Small staging dataset + live API integration for 2 user flows (search relevancy, return assistant).
2) Models: primary open model for cost/perf (see recommendations below), fallback to a slightly larger quantized variant if latency or quality issues arise.
3) Metrics: precision@3, end-to-end response latency (p50/p95), qualitative evals on 50 seed prompts per flow.

Model recommendations (initial)
- Primary: OpenLM-X-7B-instruct-quant (aggressive quantized 7B for cost predictability)
- Fallback: OpenLM-X-13B-llama-style (higher capacity, tested for ambiguity-heavy queries)
- Safety & guardrails: response length caps, simple rerank using product-fact-checking, deny-safelist for policy triggers.

Multilingual needs
- English (default) + Spanish (Mexico) for returns flow. We’ll run bilingual evals and ask for 200 native/translated samples from your support logs.

Ownership & timeline
- Redwood owner: Marissa Cole (POC operations & eval harness)
- Customer owner: Clara Huang (product) / Daniel Ortiz (engineering)
- Draft timeline: kickoff next Wednesday (2028-08-09), data ingest & sandbox by EOD 2028-08-11, first run & evals by 2028-08-18, acceptance readout 2028-08-21.

Attachments I’m sending with this note: shoply_poc_requirements.xlsx (sheet with acceptance criteria + data schema), redwood_poc_checklist.pdf. Please confirm the timeline and whether we can get the data sample (sample_conversations.jsonl) by Monday.

Next steps (please reply inline)
- Clara: confirm acceptance criteria and timeline are workable.
- Daniel: confirm you can provide a 200-sample bilingual extract and whether an S3 link or Drive upload works.

Thanks — I’ll prep the lightweight playbook and model config once you confirm.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
(Attachment: shoply_poc_requirements.xlsx, redwood_poc_checklist.pdf)

From: Clara Huang <clara@shoply.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Daniel Ortiz <d.ortiz@shoply.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Aug 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Shoply POC: success criteria, model fallback plan & owners

Thanks Karthik — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Acceptance criteria
- The CTR improvement target is reasonable, but can we also include an error-rate cap for the returns assistant (we can tolerate <= 6% incorrect eligibility guidance).

2) Data/sample
- We can provide 250 anonymized conversation snippets (EN + ES). I'll ask engineering to drop them into S3 (s3://shoply-poc/samples) by Monday EOD. The file will be a JSONL with metadata.

3) Models & latency
- We care about p95 latency staying under 1.2s for text responses in the returns flow. If that’s not achievable with the primary 7B quant option, OK to fallback automatically to the 13B variant as you suggested.

4) Compliance
- For the POC we need logs with request ids and redaction applied to PII — please confirm Redwood will share a retention policy for the trial logs.

Final: we’re happy to kick off on 2028-08-09. Please include any minimal SSO or IP allowlist steps if needed.

Regards,
Clara
Director of Product, Shoply
(Attachment: shoply_taxonomy_v1.csv)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Aug 2028 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Shoply POC — ops & model config notes

Internal note — looping the ops and model team leads so we have clear owners before kickoff. Key ops items I’ll own: infra reservations for sandbox, eval harness, and the acceptance run.

Proposed concrete config for POC
- Primary model: openlm-x-7b-instruct-q4_0 (quantized 4-bit path, faster kernel).
- Fallback: openlm-x-13b-v2 (int8 quant where possible).
- Auto-fallback policy: if p95 > 1.1s for 5 consecutive 1-hour windows OR precision@3 drops by 15% vs baseline, route to fallback variant and flag a regression ticket.
- Bilingual eval: run 50 prompt pairs (EN/ES) for returns + 50 prompts for search. Quality rubric stored in Drive link.

Compliance & logs
- We will redact user identifiers from logs and provide request_id + timestamp for each event; retention: logs stored for 14 days by default for the POC (can extend if Shoply needs). Will confirm KMS handling for S3 transfer.

Action owners
- Marissa: infra + eval harness (redwood)
- Monica: onboarding / S3 ingestion + sample validation (redwood)
- Aditya: initial model config and fallback tuning (redwood)
- Clara / Daniel: sample delivery + product acceptance

I’ll prepare a minimally opinionated model config JSON and a runbook before Monday; will also include the evaluation sheet and a short script for computing precision@3.

-Marissa
POC Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
(Internal)

Subject: Re: Shoply POC: success criteria, model fallback plan & owners

Clara / Daniel — great, thanks for the fast confirmation and for committing the sample. Quick updates and a tightened acceptance checklist based on Marissa’s note: 

Acceptance checklist (final for kickoff)
- CTR uplift >= 8% (measured over the 2-week window)
- Returns assistant error rate <= 6% (as Clara asked)
- p95 latency < 1.2s for returns flow (auto-fallback to 13B if breached under policy)
- Qualitative score >= 4/5 on 50 bilingual seed prompts

Operational notes
- Data: please upload sample_conversations.jsonl to s3://shoply-poc/samples (we’ll pull and validate). Monica will send a short validation report within 24 hours of upload.
- Logs: Redwood will provide redacted logs with request_id and timestamps; retention 14 days for POC (we can extend on request).
- Security: we’ll add Shoply IPs to the allowlist for the sandbox endpoints; Daniel, please send the CIDR ranges.

Timeline (confirmed)
- Mon 2028-08-07: final paperwork (NDA/POC addendum) executed
- Wed 2028-08-09: kickoff call + infra reservation
- Fri 2028-08-11: sample validation complete
- Fri 2028-08-18: first acceptance runs + evals complete
- Mon 2028-08-21: readout + go/no-go on expansion

Next steps for today
- Clara: share S3 link and CIDRs (if possible)
- Daniel: confirm who on your side will be the eng contact for the S3 upload (name + email)
- Marissa / Monica / Aditya: please finalize the model config and post the config + eval sheet to the Drive folder linked above.

I’ll follow up Monday with the kickoff invite and a short readme for the sample format. Looking forward to getting started.

-Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
